effect_description_eng:
While you have an [TS] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Gain 2 memory.
